about_the_game:
Seize the opportunity to showcase your skills in this top-tier racing event, transforming from an underestimated rookie into a racing star! Prove yourself with the most thrilling driving!

Join a grand tournament for elite racers and dominate the tracks through exhilarating experiences

The championship has officially begun! Competitors are racing on iconic tracks across Japan, China, America, Europe, and Africa! Whether in standard races, elimination matches, battle royales, or duels. You must seize every chance to establish your dominance and silence those who underestimate you!

Experience ultra-satisfying driving mechanics -NO BRAKES on FUN! Use the intuitive drift system to carve perfect arcs, activate nitro boosts to rocket forward! Ruthlessly squeeze and collide with opponents! Leave them watching your dust amidst explosions.

Unique catch-up system provides nitro supplements for trailing players - never lose hope when behind, never relax when ahead.

Build popularity and participate in diverse missions

Compete in main championships to gain fame, then unlock various side missions!

Drift against JDM street racers on Gunma and Hakone mountain passes. Assist city police using EMP devices to pursue fugitives. Even participate in racing movie productions - drive through alien battlefields and embark on cyber-space adventures! Unlock premium vehicles, earn public recognition, and become a racing legend!

Uncover tournament conspiracies and battle rogue AI boss

As the tournament progresses, strange rumors emerge - mysterious devices installed on racers' cars, autonomous racing vehicles. What secrets lie behind this event? Progress through main events to uncover the story through animations and text. Confront Overdrive AI in cyberspace and foil evil scientists' schemes!

Notable Features

  • Full PS/XBOX controller support!

  • Custom BGM! Put your favorite music in the folder!

  • Two endings.

  • Customizable car colors.

  • Addictive drifting and nitro mechanics.

Since the game entered internal testing, we have been genuinely grateful for the invaluable feedback from players and creators worldwide. Every piece is worthy of our careful consideration. We have decided to invest more time in a series of optimizations, including a comprehensive upgrade to the graphics quality, striving to deliver a more immersive racing world for you. To achieve the quality we all expect, the official release date is now projected to be adjusted to around April 2026. Thank you for your continued patience and support!
